## Purpose

Explain the change and which user problem it addresses.

## Testing

- [ ] `python -m unittest discover -s tests -v`
- [ ] Existing tests still pass
- [ ] Added/updated tests for modified behaviour
- [ ] Windows UI checked, if relevant (or state not tested)

## Documentation and safety

- [ ] README/help updated if features or limitations changed
- [ ] No sensitive sample PDF or personally identifiable data included
- [ ] Dependencies and licence impacts reviewed
